responsibility: This file implements the RTL resource-tracking analysis used primarily by delay-slot scheduling and late instruction motion. It computes which hard registers, condition codes, and memory resources an insn references or sets, caches live-register information at branch targets and fallthrough points, tracks end-of-function and epilogue resource requirements, and invalidates or updates cached target liveness as code is moved. Its role is the low-level dependency/resource oracle for late RTL reorganization rather than general DF analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements the late-RTL resource analysis declared in resource.h, including live-register tracking at branch targets, epilogue/end-of-function needs, and maintenance of cached target information.
